# Savi Saluwadana

Savi Saluwadana is a software engineer based in Sri Lanka who builds software in public. His project repositories document architecture, design decisions and trade-offs; he is exploring platform engineering through containers, CI/CD and developer experience.

Website: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/
GitHub: https://github.com/savisaluwadana
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/savi-saluwadana-3911331b2/
Contact: https://savisaluwadana.github.io/contact.html

## Projects and engineering work

- [Avara Real Estate](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/avara/): A Sri Lankan property platform spanning rentals, property sales and short-term bookings with role-based users, geospatial search, availability, booking workflows, payments and property operations.
- [Blu.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/blu/): A Sri Lankan home-services platform connecting customers with skilled professionals across electrical, plumbing, cleaning, AC, carpentry and other services, with customer, provider and worker-facing workflows.
- [FreshPick / FreshOnTime](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/freshpick/): A premium food-commerce platform for Colombo bringing together fresh groceries, local products, prepared meals, recurring delivery and business ordering in one customer experience.
- [TimelyHelp.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/timelyhelp/): A mental-healthcare platform for discovering licensed practitioners, booking secure consultations and managing digital care journeys. I worked on the product and frontend experience across practitioner discovery, account flows, checkout, dashboards and consultation surfaces.
- [DevRelOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/devrelos/): An operating system for discovering developer signals, managing community and content workflows, connecting developer feedback to product work, and measuring outcomes from one operational surface.
- [Property Management OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/property-os/): A rental operations platform covering properties, units, tenants, leases, rent, maintenance, documents, notifications and controlled agent-assisted operations.
- [RapidReach](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/rapidreach/): A developer publication and tool-discovery product with editorial workflows, comments, likes, search, tool profiles, media uploads and a deliberately small CMS.
- [Advance HRIS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/advance-hris/): A hybrid HR information system with an employee web portal, a native HR/admin desktop console, tenant-scoped access, policy-backed leave, schedule-aware attendance, audit history and durable offline synchronization.
- [NexusPOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/nexus-pos/): A retail POS and store-operations system covering touch checkout, barcode workflows, inventory, staff roles, cash shifts, refunds, reconciliation, audit history and native receipt printing.
- [Academix](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/academix/): A SaaS workspace for tuition centres and private institutes combining student CRM, classes, attendance, assessments, fee collection, communications, reporting and multi-site institute operations.
- [Acme Accounting](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/acme-accounting/): A single-company accounting application with a double-entry general ledger, invoicing, A/R and A/P aging, vendor bills, credit notes, refunds, period locks, bank reconciliation, budgeting and financial reporting.
- [EventOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/eventos/): An event-services marketplace and operations platform for finding suppliers, comparing quotes, managing bookings and contracts, tracking payments and coordinating event delivery.
- [Plate Restaurant OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/restaurantos/): A restaurant-management product bringing point of sale, table service, direct online ordering, kitchen workflows, menus and inventory into one operational workspace.
- [Pain Intelligence Lab](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/pain-intelligence/): An early community research project for exploring recurring needs using source-linked evidence. The current repository provides a local Next.js and Rust web app and a separate desktop app.
- [Ad Performance Analysis Agent](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/ad-performance-agent/): A campaign-performance analysis prototype that parses ad-data CSVs, compares weekly metrics, highlights risks and wins, and uses Gemini to help produce actionable summaries.
- [MediCare](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/medicare/): A patient and clinic-management system covering patient administration, appointments, clinical records, billing, staff permissions and an embeddable scheduling service.

# Product implementation references

## Avara Real Estate

A Sri Lankan property platform spanning rentals, property sales and short-term bookings with role-based users, geospatial search, availability, booking workflows, payments and property operations.

Repository: https://github.com/RealEstateSassApplication/AvaraRealEstate/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js → MongoDB → S3 → PayHere

Current boundary: This diagram summarizes the repository’s property, booking and payment boundaries. PayHere and S3 require deployment-specific configuration.

Local setup: Configure MongoDB and environment variables; npm install; npm run dev

Licence: Proprietary, all rights reserved

Decision: A single Next.js app handles property workflows and MongoDB storage.

Trade-off: A unified app is easier to run, but payment and media require configured external services.

Unfinished: Production checklist and external payment/storage configuration remain.


---

## Blu.lk

A Sri Lankan home-services platform connecting customers with skilled professionals across electrical, plumbing, cleaning, AC, carpentry and other services, with customer, provider and worker-facing workflows.

Repository: https://blu.lk/

Architecture: Customer + provider experiences → Laravel API → MySQL

Current boundary: This diagram covers the core service platform. Payment-provider availability depends on integration configuration; no specific online payment launch is claimed here.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## FreshPick / FreshOnTime

A premium food-commerce platform for Colombo bringing together fresh groceries, local products, prepared meals, recurring delivery and business ordering in one customer experience.

Repository: https://github.com/FreshOnTime/newfreshontimewebsite/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js → Prisma / PostgreSQL → recurring delivery + media storage

Current boundary: Customer checkout and subscription baskets currently use cash on delivery. Automatic recurring card charging is not implemented. Subscription baskets and recurring grocery orders are distinct workflows.

Local setup: Set development environment variables; npm ci; npm run db:migrate; npm run dev

Licence: No licence identified

Decision: Next.js route handlers enforce commerce rules using Prisma and PostgreSQL.

Trade-off: One app keeps order transitions together; background jobs and integrations need separate scheduling.

Unfinished: Automatic recurring card charging is not implemented; agentic commerce is planned.


---

## TimelyHelp.lk

A mental-healthcare platform for discovering licensed practitioners, booking secure consultations and managing digital care journeys. I worked on the product and frontend experience across practitioner discovery, account flows, checkout, dashboards and consultation surfaces.

Repository: https://timelyhelp.lk/

Architecture: Next.js 15 → NextAuth → practitioner APIs → Zoom Video SDK

Current boundary: Savi’s portfolio contribution is product and frontend work. This page summarizes that frontend boundary and does not claim ownership of the full clinical backend.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## DevRelOS

An operating system for discovering developer signals, managing community and content workflows, connecting developer feedback to product work, and measuring outcomes from one operational surface.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js → Go API → PostgreSQL → Workers → MCP

Current boundary: This project is a self-hosted beta. External providers require credentials and policy configuration; consequential outreach follows approval workflows.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## Property Management OS

A rental operations platform covering properties, units, tenants, leases, rent, maintenance, documents, notifications and controlled agent-assisted operations.

Repository: https://github.com/RealEstateSassApplication/property-management-OS/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js → Go modular monolith → PostgreSQL → Outbox worker → MCP

Current boundary: MCP calls the same authenticated HTTP API as other clients and has no direct database connection. Advanced financial writes and other domains remain subject to the project’s implemented tool scope.

Local setup: Set values from .env.example; docker compose up --build

Licence: No licence identified

Decision: Go modular monolith keeps domain rules and authorisation behind authenticated APIs; notification writes use an outbox.

Trade-off: Transactional domain authority stays in one backend, but asynchronous delivery needs worker and retry handling.

Unfinished: README lists remaining milestones; some agentic mutations are outside the current tool scope.


---

## RapidReach

A developer publication and tool-discovery product with editorial workflows, comments, likes, search, tool profiles, media uploads and a deliberately small CMS.

Repository: https://github.com/savisaluwadana/RapidReachBloWebsite/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js → MongoDB → object storage

Current boundary: RapidReach uses one Next.js application with MongoDB and Blob storage; there is no separate backend service. Publishing and media require a configured deployment.

Local setup: Configure MongoDB in .env.local; npm install; npm run dev

Licence: No licence identified

Decision: Next.js handles the CMS, page delivery and APIs, backed by MongoDB and blob media.

Trade-off: One deployable app reduces boundaries, but media and publishing rely on configured external services.

Unfinished: Production media storage and environment configuration remain deployment responsibilities.


---

## Advance HRIS

A hybrid HR information system with an employee web portal, a native HR/admin desktop console, tenant-scoped access, policy-backed leave, schedule-aware attendance, audit history and durable offline synchronization.

Repository: https://github.com/SilverLine-Ravija/Advance-HIRS-System/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js Web + Wails / React Desktop → Go API → PostgreSQL

Current boundary: Local-first refers to the desktop console. The cloud database remains authoritative. Payroll-ready attendance boundaries do not mean a complete payroll-processing product is included.

Local setup: Configure .env from example; docker compose up --build (demo setup)

Licence: No licence identified

Decision: Cloud HR data is authoritative; the desktop uses a local store and sync queue.

Trade-off: Offline operation adds synchronization, conflict resolution and local-data protection concerns.

Unfinished: Default Compose is demo-only; full payroll and production layers remain unfinished.


---

## NexusPOS

A retail POS and store-operations system covering touch checkout, barcode workflows, inventory, staff roles, cash shifts, refunds, reconciliation, audit history and native receipt printing.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js / React → Prisma → MongoDB + Electron

Current boundary: Electron is an optional desktop shell. The portfolio does not claim a complete offline checkout engine or a tenant-isolated hosted retail service.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## Academix

A SaaS workspace for tuition centres and private institutes combining student CRM, classes, attendance, assessments, fee collection, communications, reporting and multi-site institute operations.

Repository: https://github.com/savisaluwadana/student-management-system-saas/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js → MongoDB / Mongoose → notification integrations

Current boundary: The account and plan surfaces support a SaaS direction. Automated billing and broader tenant-isolation work should be checked against the current project roadmap rather than assumed complete.

Local setup: Configure environment and database; npm install; npm run dev

Licence: No licence identified

Decision: Next.js and MongoDB implement student, class and fee workflows in one application.

Trade-off: Combined modules ease local development but verified tenant isolation and billing need more work.

Unfinished: Shared tenancy verification, production permissions, billing and deployment acceptance remain.


---

## Acme Accounting

A single-company accounting application with a double-entry general ledger, invoicing, A/R and A/P aging, vendor bills, credit notes, refunds, period locks, bank reconciliation, budgeting and financial reporting.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js → MongoDB / Mongoose → double-entry ledger

Current boundary: The current application is designed for one company and one administrator identity per database. It is not a tenant-isolated accounting SaaS backend.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## EventOS

An event-services marketplace and operations platform for finding suppliers, comparing quotes, managing bookings and contracts, tracking payments and coordinating event delivery.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js → PostgreSQL → transactional workflows + file storage

Current boundary: Payments are submitted and reconciled manually in the current MVP. This is a Next.js and PostgreSQL application; a Supabase service is not required for the documented runtime.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## Plate Restaurant OS

A restaurant-management product bringing point of sale, table service, direct online ordering, kitchen workflows, menus and inventory into one operational workspace.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js → authenticated API routes → MongoDB

Current boundary: The product is under development. POS, kitchen and online ordering share a Next.js application and MongoDB data layer; external integrations require deployment-specific configuration.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## Pain Intelligence Lab

An early community research project for exploring recurring needs using source-linked evidence. The current repository provides a local Next.js and Rust web app and a separate desktop app.

Repository: https://github.com/savisaluwadana/Pain-Point-Analyzer/blob/main/README.md

Architecture: Next.js dashboard → Rust API → PostgreSQL; separate desktop app

Current boundary: The repository currently describes an early community alpha for local use. The web app and desktop app have different capabilities; source content retains third-party data-use restrictions.

Local setup: Configure .env from example; docker compose up --build -d --wait

Licence: MIT

Decision: The repository offers a local Next.js/Rust/PostgreSQL web stack and a separate desktop edition.

Trade-off: Local research keeps the data close to the user but two editions have distinct setup and capabilities.

Unfinished: Early community alpha: README lists connector, import and third-party data limitations.


---

## Ad Performance Analysis Agent

A campaign-performance analysis prototype that parses ad-data CSVs, compares weekly metrics, highlights risks and wins, and uses Gemini to help produce actionable summaries.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: React / Vite → Express → CSV analysis + Gemini → email

Current boundary: Google Ads and Supermetrics connection endpoints are currently mocks. Scheduled demonstration runs use generated sample CSVs and in-memory configuration, rather than a durable live account-ingestion pipeline.

Other product, source not publicly linked


---

## MediCare

A patient and clinic-management system covering patient administration, appointments, clinical records, billing, staff permissions and an embeddable scheduling service.

Repository: No confirmed public source link

Architecture: Next.js → Go API + scheduling service → PostgreSQL

Current boundary: The main clinic API and embeddable scheduling API use separate service boundaries. Server-enforced roles separate clinical, billing and administrative access.

Other product, source not publicly linked
